bears.name: Chicago Bears
bears.summary: The Chicago Bears improved to 5-2 after Caleb Williams and the Chicago Bears secured a valuable primetime victory after beating the New England Patriots 30-24 at home on Thursday night , with kicker Cairo Santos sealing it on a career-long 58-yard field goal. The win came at a cost, however, as the Bears placed tight end Cole Kmet on injured reserve after a season-ending knee injury, while also having their suspension on defensive lineman Montez Sweat lifted by the league.

lions.name: Detroit Lions
lions.summary: Tight end Sam LaPorta publicly voiced frustration over his contract situation, with Dan Campbell and teammate Jack Campbell addressing the fallout as the team prepares for Sunday Night Football against Green Bay. On the injury front, Detroit is set to get major reinforcements back for Week 7, as Pro Bowl safety Brian Branch, who said "I'm ready to roll," and center Cade Mays near their season debuts against the Packers.

packers.name: Green Bay Packers
packers.summary: The Green Bay Packers' defense suffered another setback ahead of Sunday's Week 7 showdown at Detroit, as head coach Matt LaFleur confirmed linebacker Zaire Franklin, who was on the injury report Thursday with a shin issue, will miss Week 7 against the Detroit Lions . This loss compounds Green Bay's linebacker troubles since Franklin's absence creates another challenge for Green Bay's defense, which has already lost starting linebacker Edgerrin Cooper for the season because of an Achilles tendon tear suffered in Week 4, leaving the Packers without both of their Week 1 starting linebackers for the trip to Detroit .

vikings.name: Minnesota Vikings
vikings.summary: The Minnesota Vikings, coming off their bye week at 5-0, are set to host the Indianapolis Colts on Sunday with an otherwise nearly clean injury report, as Head Coach Kevin O'Connell says RB Jordan Mason will enter Sunday's game as questionable while in his 21-day return to practice window . In a corresponding roster move, the Vikings officially re-signed outside linebacker Jihad Ward to their practice squad on Friday and released rookie offensive lineman Tristan Leigh to make room for Ward.
